entries.3c61418feedb1376: The company has formulated a new medium-term management plan, “SUSTAINABLE STRONG & EXPAND 2028 (SSE2028),” covering the three years from fiscal 2026 through fiscal 2028, and states that it aims to improve medium- to long-term corporate value through three foundation strategies (practicing sustainability management, strengthening human capital, and strengthening financial foundation and governance) and two business strategies (sustained growth and deepening of the core business, and creating value-added business through AI／DX). It also shows an evolution toward becoming a “data-driven solution provider.”

entries.4953dddc58664d71: It handles electrical measuring instruments such as ammeters, voltmeters, power measuring instruments and recorders, as well as oscilloscopes, communication measuring instruments and measurement systems. entries.4ea9acfa1ed846b5: This is a single-segment business that sells various electronic applied equipment, such as measurement and control instruments and physics and chemistry instruments, and performs the engineering work that accompanies those sales. As an agency for [[company:yokogawa-electric|Yokogawa Electric Corporation]], Yokogawa Solution Service Corporation and Agilent Technologies Japan, Ltd., it purchases the main products; for system sales, it orders machinery and instrumentation construction work from engineering and construction companies, which manufacture and install them. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥45,220 million.
entries.56a47f9c1df54709: It handles control computers and computer systems for process automation (PA) and factory automation (FA), detection instruments such as thermometers and flowmeters, and control devices such as controllers and sequencers, and it takes on engineering, software production, instrumentation construction and maintenance services. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥22,571 million.
entries.61a137a63b643744: The company provides products and services to customers across a wide range of industries, including petroleum and chemical plants, lifeline-related fields, automotive, semiconductor and telecommunications, and food and pharmaceuticals. There are no specific customers that account for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.6257fe09e38a0b26: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥45,220 million, an increase of 16.8% from the previous year. Control and information equipment systems are the largest, followed by physical and chemical equipment, industrial equipment and others, and measuring instruments.

entries.86aca599fd297b81: This is a business model in which it purchases measurement and control equipment and physical and chemical instruments from manufacturers such as Yokogawa Electric Corporation and sells them to industrial customers, earning revenue together with fees for engineering and maintenance services.
entries.88a46a12b5e96dc2: The strategy has a two-tier structure: it deepens and grows the existing sales base in measurement, control and physical and chemical equipment by market, while developing, as a new pillar, a value-added business that integrates on-site know-how and data through AI／DX. It is positioned as the plan that follows the previous medium-term management plan, “Strong＆Expanding2025” (fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2025).

entries.d8c8222f2105f101: Since its founding in 1932, NISHIKAWA KEISOKU Co., Ltd. has expanded its business, starting from the sale of measuring instruments, and has its head office in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended June 2026 is 411.
entries.d9a01a0110d7c093: An engineering trading company that sells measurement and control instruments and scientific instruments, and handles instrumentation work and maintenance as a package.
entries.e5a77c79192002ad: The company states that, with measurement, control and physical and chemical engineering as its foundation, it will work to provide close, detailed service to customers and fully demonstrate its problem-solving capability as an engineering trading company. The company positions its initiatives addressing social infrastructure such as electricity, water and gas, and environmental issues as core businesses.
entries.e8a32ed835f5d03d: The company has a single segment. By product and service, revenue from external customers is largest for control and information equipment systems at ¥22,571 million, followed by physical and chemical equipment at ¥10,518 million, industrial equipment and others at ¥6,328 million, and measuring instruments at ¥5,801 million. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of the total, and there are no specific customers accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
